description: Put the waiting changes on the real site — this is what VISITORS see, so only ever on an explicit request ("mach das live", "veröffentliche das"), never on your own initiative after finishing a change. Write `description` in the user's own words and in their language ("Tag der offenen Tür angekündigt"), because that sentence is what they will read next month when they want to go back. Only for apps that publish on request; an app that publishes automatically has nothing to publish.

description.description: What changed, in the user's words — shown in their version list
